title: Single-Solution Bounds for Diophantine Equations
exact_target: Can Matiyasevich’s theorem for exponential Diophantine equations—an equation with at most one solution in the variables for each parameter, while some parameter has a solution exceeding every prescribed total effectively computable bound—be improved to genuine Diophantine equations without exponentiation, possibly allowing finitely many rather than at most one solution?
